## How to read this

- **Popularity** gives everyone the same list. A few mitigations, such as auditing and user training, apply to most techniques, so it is a hard bar. A model that does not clear it has learned nothing about the behaviour.
- Skandamata **recommends**; it does not act. In Sati, a recommended response is an action proposal that Dharma must authorise (rule 2).
